_source: awk of calls the persona answers another way (more arguments than parameters, an undefined function on a later line, an array where a scalar is expected, gawk's own strftime and builtin names), `docker run --rm --network none -e P=PROGRAM IMAGE sh -c 'awk "$P"'`, 2026-10-27, Docker on linux/arm64 (every image is its linux/arm64 variant of the index digest below except busybox_1.25.1, busybox:1.25, linux/amd64 under emulation, which has no arm64 variant; the `platform` of each image says which; `version` is the first line of the awk's own version output; LANG and LC_ALL unset). `programs` holds the program of every case name, `cases` [stdout, stderr, status] as the container answered. Nothing normalised.

programs.extra_args: function f(x) { return x } BEGIN { print f(1, 2); print "after" }
programs.extra_args_unrun: function f(x) { return x } BEGIN { print "before"; if (0) print f(1, 2); print "after" }
programs.extra_args_arr: function f(x) { return x } BEGIN { a[1] = 1; print f(1, a); print "after" }
programs.scalar_to_array: function f(a) { a[1] = 1 } BEGIN { x = 1; f(x); print "ok" }
programs.array_to_scalar: function f(a) { return a + 1 } BEGIN { b[1] = 1; print f(b) }
programs.array_to_scalar_unused: function f(a) { return 1 } BEGIN { b[1] = 1; print f(b) }
programs.function_strftime: function strftime(a) { return a } BEGIN { print strftime(1) }
programs.function_mktime: function mktime(a) { return a } BEGIN { print mktime(1) }

programs.function_patsplit: function patsplit(a) { return a } BEGIN { print patsplit(1) }
